name: Ranger: Incendiary Arrows consumes charges on Emerald Arrow dummy hits and lethal Assault kills, never on DoT-only spenders (#10385)
contract: Issue #10385 (Incendiary Shot 524870 -> Incendiary Arrows 524869): 'Direct damage that use advantage now consume
Incendiary Shot stack, but sometimes it not consumed.' AscensionRangerArchery.cpp had three defects in its
Incendiary Arrows tracking: (1) landedDamage was keyed only by {player, target} and consumed unconditionally by
any family-27 spell with damage == 0, so on a training dummy (32666, whose DamageTaken zeroes scriptDamageResult)
Emerald Arrow (806925) triggered Enchanted Flare (801935, speed 0, damage 0) in ranger_secondary_hits BEFORE
ranger_archery_hits ran, stealing and erasing Emerald Arrow's saved damage so Emerald Arrow neither exploded nor
spent a charge; (2) landedDamage was never cleared on normal hits and recorded Incendiary Shot itself while
IsIncendiarySpender omitted a direct-damage check, so casting a DoT-only Advantage spender (Serrated Shot 500073)
popped stale damage and falsely exploded; (3) Assault (503105) triggers Assaulted (582830) during HandleLaunchPhase
before Assault's own DoAllEffectOnTarget, so when 582830 kills a low-HP enemy, Assault exits early at Spell.cpp:2671
without invoking OnSpellHitResult and no explosion or charge consumption occurs. Phase 1 (DISCRIMINATING) hits mob
with Incendiary Shot then casts Serrated Shot 500073: charges must stay at 3 with 0 explosions on mob_near. Phase 2
(DISCRIMINATING) refreshes Incendiary Arrows and casts Emerald Arrow 806925 on training dummy 32666: tdummy_near
must take 1 Incendiary Explosion (570182) and charges must drop 3 -> 2. Phase 3 (DISCRIMINATING) sets lowhp to
10 HP (below 20%) and kills it with Assault 503105 via 582830: melee_near must take 1 Incendiary Explosion (570182)
